title: Collection
description: A named gathering of assets, made by a person because they belong together for a reason no pipeline would find. It holds no assets: it holds the edges that say which ones are in it, and when each was put there.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

session.description: The id of the working session it was made in, in the system that owns the session. Absent when it was not made through one.

name.description: What it is called, in the words of whoever gathered it.

description.description: Why these belong together. Written by a person; never derived from what is inside.

assets.description: The assets in it, each as its own edge: being in a collection is not an attribute of an asset, and the moment it was added belongs to the putting-in, not to either side.

id.description: The edge's own id in the system that holds it.

asset.description: The id of the asset, in the system that owns it.

addedAt.description: When it was put in, which is not when the asset was recorded.
